latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of china-beauty-factory skill:

- Comprehensive guide for international buyers on China's beauty industry manufacturing clusters and supply chain structure.
- Covers skincare, color cosmetics, hair care, body care, fragrances, and men's grooming.
- Provides up-to-date industry intelligence, including 2026 trends and government policy developments.
- Includes practical advice on supplier selection, factory evaluation, lead times, and payment terms.
- Features cluster-level data and regional specialization insights with no individual factory contacts.
